title: Exchanging a damaged purchase
objectives: Explain the defect in the jacket
Offer the receipt and request an exchange
State the size and colour you want

courseTemplate.setting: The customer bought the jacket last week and has the receipt. The zipper is broken. The same size in navy is in stock.
courseTemplate.openingLine: Hi! What can I do for you today?

targetPatterns.pattern: I bought this jacket last week, but the zipper is broken.
targetPatterns.example: I bought this jacket last week, but the zipper is broken.

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes, here it is. Can I exchange it for another one?
targetPatterns.example: Yes, here it is. Can I exchange it for another one?

targetPatterns.pattern: The same size, please, but in navy if you have it.
targetPatterns.example: The same size, please, but in navy if you have it.

targetPatterns.pattern: Do you have this in a smaller size?
targetPatterns.example: Do you have this in a smaller size?

targetPatterns.pattern: Can I get a refund if it doesn't fit?
targetPatterns.example: Can I get a refund if it doesn't fit?

targetPatterns.pattern: Is there any discount on this?
targetPatterns.example: Is there any discount on this?

targetPatterns.pattern: Do you have a tax refund service?
targetPatterns.example: Do you have a tax refund service?

targetPatterns.pattern: This is a gift — could you wrap it?
targetPatterns.example: This is a gift — could you wrap it?
targetPatterns.translation: 这是礼物，能帮忙包装吗？

stages.title: Explain the defect in the jacket
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hi! What can I do for you today?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain the defect in the jacket in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I bought this jacket …”

stages.title: Offer the receipt and request an exchange
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?”
successCriteria: The learner can offer the receipt and request an exchange in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, here it is. …”

stages.title: State the size and colour you want
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Of course. Would you like the same size and colour?”
successCriteria: The learner can state the size and colour you want in their own words.
hints: You can start with “The same size, please, …”

languageNotes: 「便宜」的 cheap 带贬义（廉价劣质），说价格好可以用 good value；「试穿」是 try on，不是 "try it"。

modelDialogue.text: Hi! What can I do for you today?
I bought this jacket last week, but the zipper is broken.
I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?
Yes, here it is. Can I exchange it for another one?
Of course. Would you like the same size and colour?
The same size, please, but in navy if you have it.
